error.timeout: A timeout occurred, please try again

init.description: Set default options when changing the thermostat temperature.

data.use_comfort_mode: Set the regulation to comfort mode when changing the temperature.
data.comfort_mode_duration: The duration in minutes the comfort mode should be enabled.

set_vacation.name: Set vacation
set_vacation.description: Schedule a vacation for the thermostat's group (WD5 series). The vacation runs from 00:00 on the start date until 00:00 on the end date; if it has already started, vacation mode is activated immediately.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: The first day of the vacation.

cancel_vacation.name: Cancel vacation
cancel_vacation.description: Cancel the scheduled or active vacation for the thermostat's group (WD5 series). An active vacation returns to schedule or manual mode, whichever was used last.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Set the events of one or more weekdays in the thermostat group's weekly schedule (WD5 series). Up to 6 events per day, on the quarter hour, at least 15 minutes apart; a time earlier than the previous one is after midnight (03:00 at the latest).

events.name: Events
events.description: The day's events in order, each with a time (HH:MM) and a temperature (5-40 °C).
